display.purpose: Hero headers and high-impact category banners

components.name: Crimson Primary Button
components.description: Tactile crimson gradient button with inset light and shadow glow
components.css: .ds-btn-crimson { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e04b4f 0%, #c93b41 50%, #ba3239 100%); color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 700; font-family: sans-serif; border: none; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(201, 59, 65, 0.35), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-crimson:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e75050 0%, #d84242 50%, #c93b41 100%); box-shadow: 0 6px 25px rgba(201, 59, 65, 0.5), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Crimson Glass Badge
components.description: Pill badge for status and highlights
components.css: .ds-badge-crimson { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; background-color: #fef2f2; border: 1px solid #fecaca; color: #c93b41; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(201, 59, 65, 0.06); }

narrative.overview: Etbaaly's visual system evokes the tactile, tangible precision of high-end printmaking and luxury packaging. It balances industrial manufacturing capability with boutique agency aesthetics.
keyCharacteristics: Crimson Accents: High-energy brand red used purposefully on interactive levers.
Dual Surface Logic: Seamless dark mode (#1d1d1d) and light mode (#f8f9fa).
Tactile Card & Pill Architecture: Layered elevation with subtle glass borders.
RTL Fluidity: Arabic typography with generous line heights.

rules.name: The 10% Crimson Rule
rules.body: Crimson Red is a deliberate accent; it must never exceed 10% of any viewport's surface area.

rules.name: The Dual Surface Rule
rules.body: Every card and surface token must explicitly resolve in both light and dark mode without losing border definition.

rules.name: The Crisp Arabic Rendering Rule
rules.body: Avoid artificial bolding filters on Lateef; rely on clean font weights to maintain vector sharpness.

rules.name: The Flat Canvas Depth Rule
rules.body: Dark backgrounds remain flat (#1d1d1d); elevation is communicated through step-up tonal surfaces and hairline borders.

dos: Do maintain RTL direction and right-aligned text hierarchy across all components.
Do implement shimmer skeleton screens (loading.tsx) on every dynamic route.
Do use .btn-crimson for main conversion actions.
donts: Don't use pure black (#000000) for dark backgrounds; use Charcoal (#1d1d1d).
Don't allow layout shift on asset load; always set explicit image dimensions.
